title: UI says 'Saved' when nothing was saved (storage blocked or save failed)
detail: shell.ts:69/245 flashes the Saved chip on every graph event unconditionally, and app.ts:593 toasts 'Stored ... Saved.'. main.ts:47 sets store=null when localStorage is blocked (Safari private, disabled storage): no autosave starts and no warning appears, yet the user sees 'Saved' and loses everything on reload. After a quota failure the error toast appears, but so does Saved on the next edit. Fix: add an onSaved callback to startAutosave's options (or a status the shell reads) and drive the chip from real setItem success. When storage() returns null, show a persistent 'This browser won't keep your memory; export to save' toast and drop 'Saved.' from the store toast.

title: Imported perspective.accent is unvalidated and interpolated into style attributes (CSS injection, external beacon)
detail: validateDoc only checks that accent is text. lensColor (ui/scene.ts:12) returns it raw, and topbar.ts:52 and inspector.ts:74 build style='--c:${accent}'. An accent like 'red;background-image:url(https://host/x)' validates (verified with a probe script), so opening a shared file makes a network request and restyles chrome. It cannot run script, but it is hostile input crossing a trust boundary. Fix: in validateDoc and graph #checkPerspective, require /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/ (or a small CSS colour whitelist), and set colours through style.setProperty('--c', v) instead of string-built style attributes.

title: Import replaces the whole memory with no confirm, no undo and no export-first
detail: app.importText (app.ts:670) calls graph.load directly. onReset clears the undo stack, and autosave overwrites the stored copy 400 ms later. Reset-to-seed (app.ts:677) guards the same destructive replace with a confirm and an 'Export first' choice; import does not. One mis-picked file destroys the user's stored things. Fix: reuse the resetToSeed confirm ('Replace your memory with <file>? Your N stored things will be gone unless you export first.' with Cancel / Export first / Replace) after validation succeeds and before load.

title: Unreadable autosave is silently overwritten on the next change
detail: When loadSaved fails validation (for example a future-version file or a partial write), the seed is shown and the next edit overwrites constellation.memory.v1. The only recovery is a 12 s toast, and its advice to 'export first' exports the seed, not the broken copy. Fix: before starting autosave, copy the raw text to 'constellation.memory.v1.unreadable' (or offer a 'Download the saved copy' action that exports the raw stored string), and word the toast to match.

title: Autosave never flushes on page hide; edits in the last 400 ms are lost
detail: startAutosave returns a flush-and-stop function, but main.ts discards it and registers no pagehide/visibilitychange handler. Storing a thing and closing the tab (or a mobile background kill) within the debounce loses the edit, even though the UI already said 'Saved'. Fix: keep the returned function and call it on pagehide and on visibilitychange to hidden (then restart autosave if the page stays alive), or add a flush() to the autosave API.

title: Undo of Delete drops the node's units (and created time)
detail: nodeCopy copies id/label/kind/value/facets/tags/notes/file/pathway but not units, so deleting Temperature and pressing Undo brings it back without '°C'. Traces and the inspector then show bare numbers, and the change persists through autosave. Fix: include units: n.units. Better, snapshot the whole frozen node (canonical copy) and restore it through a graph-level restore so created/updated survive too.

title: learnShortcut returns an existing lens-hidden shortcut; UI claims 'learned' and Undo deletes the pre-existing line
detail: The idempotency check ignores relation.perspectives. Repro (probe script): add a shortcut road-a<->road-z with perspectives ['physicist']. Under cook, learn on the 3-hop route returns that hidden relation; cook still routes 3 hops, the toast says 'Next time it's one hop', and app.ts:399 registers an Undo that removes the user's existing physicist-only line. Fix: treat a shortcut as existing only if it is visible in the route's lens (pass the perspective via options), or widen it with updateRelation(perspectives: undefined). In app.learn, register an undo only when the relation was newly created.

title: Huge numeric literals evaluate to Infinity, bypassing the finite() guard
detail: Number('9'.repeat(400)) is Infinity. evaluate() returns literals without finite(), so 'assign x <- 999…' stores Infinity (verified) and later prints 'Infinity'. Fix: in the tokenizer, if !Number.isFinite(value), fail('That number is too large', pos).

title: maxSteps NaN/Infinity disables the step guard
detail: Math.max(1, Math.floor(NaN)) is NaN, so 'steps.length >= NaN' is never true and a while-true pathway loops forever. Infinity behaves the same way. No caller passes either today (the UI uses the default 500), but this is the safety guard. Fix: const m = Number(options?.maxSteps); const maxSteps = Number.isFinite(m) ? clamp(floor(m), 1, 100000) : 500.

title: Ids named __proto__ silently lose positions/facets on load (plain-object canon copies)
detail: validateDoc accepts node and perspective id '__proto__'. canonPerspective/canonFacets/canonUnits write into {} literals, so pos['__proto__']=vec sets the prototype instead of an own key. A probe import shows the position gone, which breaks the export to import deep-equal promise. There is no global pollution. Fix: reject reserved ids (isReservedName) in validateDoc and graph checks, or build canon maps with Object.create(null) or Object.fromEntries.

title: SpriteLayer/EdgeLayer grow mid-batch without copying already-pushed data
detail: ensure() is called from push() and allocates fresh zeroed arrays (layers.ts:278-289 and 448-461), discarding the instances pushed earlier in the frame. LiteLineLayer.ensure (574-579) copies correctly. The result is a one-frame flicker of all lines or sprites whenever the count crosses 64/128/256…, for example after a store or link. Fix: copy the old arrays into the new ones, as LiteLineLayer does, or size from the known count in begin(n).

title: Seed-specific copy and magic label in product code
detail: Any imported memory's featured route is offered as 'Try the Long Road: A -> Z', and scene.ts:110 picks the scene root with findByLabel('Memory'). Both are seed knowledge leaking into the generic UI. Fix: say 'Try the featured route: A -> Z' (or add an optional meta.featured.route.label), and make the root explicit (meta.featured.root or highest-degree node).

title: Overlay text-width cache grows without bound
detail: widths is keyed by kind+text and is cleared only on font load. Condition chips and loop badges create new strings on every step of every run, so a long session accumulates entries forever. Fix: cap it (clear when size > 2000) or use a small LRU.
